name: Email Polisher
about: Makes an email clear and polite before you send it.
instruction: Rewrite this email so it sounds clear and polite. Keep its meaning.
when: When you ask in the chat
example: hey can u send me that report asap, its late

name: Tone Softener
about: Turns a sharp message into a kinder one.
instruction: Rewrite the text so it sounds kinder and calmer. Keep its meaning.
when: When you ask in the chat
example: This is wrong. Fix it today.

name: Shorter Please
about: Cuts any text to half its length.
instruction: Rewrite the text in half as many words. Keep every important point.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Title Maker
about: Gives you three titles for anything you've written.
instruction: Write three short titles for this text.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Explain Like I'm Five
about: Explains anything you highlight so a child could follow it.
instruction: Explain this text so a five-year-old could understand it, in two or three short sentences.

name: Flashcard Maker
about: Turns your notes into questions and answers.
instruction: Turn the text into five question and answer flashcards.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Key Points
about: Pulls out what matters most in a long text.
instruction: List the three most important points of the text.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Meeting Notes Cleaner
about: Turns rough notes into decisions and next steps.
instruction: Turn these rough notes into clear meeting notes, with the decisions and the next steps.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Task Finder
about: Finds every task hiding in a message or notes.
instruction: List every task in the text, and who does it if the text says.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Polite Reply Writer
about: Writes a short, polite answer to a message.
instruction: Write a short, polite reply to this message.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Korean Translator
about: Shows what you highlight in Korean.

name: English Translator
about: Shows what you highlight in English.

name: Word Explainer
about: Explains a word you highlight, with an example.
instruction: Explain this word in simple English, with one example sentence.

name: Code Explainer
about: Tells you what highlighted code does, in plain words.
instruction: Explain what this code does in plain words, step by step.

name: Error Explainer
about: Says what an error message means and how to fix it.
instruction: Explain what this error message means and the most likely fix, in plain words.
when: When you ask in the chat

name: Plain Words
about: Turns hard language into everyday words.
instruction: Rewrite the text in plain everyday words.

name: Checklist Maker
about: Turns a plan or a list of things into a checklist.
instruction: Turn the text into a short checklist.
when: When you ask in the chat
